title: stelis quadrifida
intro: Stelis quadrifida, commonly known as the Four-leafed Stelis, is a flowering plant species in the orchid family, known for its unique four-leafed foliage. Research has shown that the plant possesses various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis quadrifida include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi, as well as its potential to act as an anti-diabetic agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
